title: 短いレール床付き車止め
titleEn: Railway buffer stop with short rail bed
description: 線路終端を表現する静的な車止め。短い一対の断面付きレール、枕木、レール締結部、三角形の補強フレーム、斜材と横補強、幅広の緩衝梁とゴム接触面を備えます。列車、連続線路、バラスト・地盤は含まず、耐衝突性能や軌道規格の適合を示しません。レール区間は本車止めの一体的な設置表現であり、独立した追加素材ではありません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）2.110 × 1.382 × 2.360 m、21,640三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A static railway end-stop assembly with a short pair of profiled rails, timber sleepers, rail fasteners, reinforced triangular frames, diagonal and lateral braces, a wide buffer beam and elastomer contact faces. No train, continuous track, ballast or terrain is supplied, and no collision performance or railway-standard compliance is implied. The short rail bed is integral installation context for this one asset, not an independently counted track asset. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 2.110 × 1.382 × 2.360 m; 21,640 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
